notes.title: 1.0.35 - 100% DEATHLESS & QOL & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the positive reviews after the launch!
It's always fun to watch people play through and get a hang of the controls for the first time! 


The main things I wanted to address with this update:
I noticed some people playing multiplayer for the first time didn't get to experience the outro - this was due to the outro being skipped by default when in a multiplayer game. 

Solution? The outro is unskippable on first playthrough, just like the skip intro toggle. It wont care whether or not you're in a multiplayer game, it'll either play or not depending on the option.



The any% world record is 9:29.914 which is absolutely mind blowing! Congrats to UULaCrevette
[previewyoutube="v1bEdiIyb2U;full"][/previewyoutube]
He also holds the record for 100% and DEATHLESS too which is why this update is so important.



..drumroll...

INTRODUCING DEATHLESS 100% 
A new challenge for only the most insane players. You asked for it and now you have it! (not sure why)

It's really, really, really hard - but you get an achievement so idk maybe it's worth it to you.

Sections of the map have been modified slightly to allow for a deathless run where collecting all flamingos and no scoping every pool is possible without a single death. There was previously a few "YOLO Flamingos" that have become a little bit more sensible with time.
HAVE FUN
and remember to come join the Discord if you wanna start running and want some tips on routing!



Changes:

Geometry changes to allow for 100% Deathless

Skip Outro toggle added to gameplay settings

No more freeze bug on moving platforms

Should no longer be possible to reach below the pool i mean ocean

2 Manager death planes modified slightly

Escalations middle death plane removed

Remember to Join the Community & click all them links below!

notes.title: 1.0.23 - Multiplayer Update [BETA]
notes.notes:
v1.0.23
● BETA Multiplayer! Hit F11 when in game (uses IP address connection, not steam yet) Port is 10277
● Moved beach ball out of pool to avoid insta-setting of achievement on first play
● Auto-unstuck toggle in options (shouldn't count as a respawn when you do it out of a stuck position)
● Decreased sensitivity of stuck detection
● Ground / respawn point detection made more lenient + bug fix where back section of wheelchair wasn't being checked, leading to annoying respawns
● Fixed unreliable FPS Camera button
● New Skin
● Skins and cosmetics wont change between runs while the game is open

Note: Multiplayer wont have proper Steam integration for a while, it will remain a BETA feature until then.

We were going to keep this a testing-only beta feature but we were enjoying it so much I decided to release it upon the world. It's still quite buggy but I am continuously working on it.

If you want some people to play with, come join the Discord!
